shape_hint: Plain hexagon prism with a central threaded through-hole; side view is a rectangle of height H, top view is a regular hexagon with flats F across and corners G; a 30-degree chamfer on the corners of one or both faces gives the washer-faced look. A jam nut is the same hexagon but thinner (H1, about 1/2 to 2/3 of H).

role_map.F_basic: width across flats, basic (wrench size, fraction)

notes: Standard = ASME B18.2.2 finished hex nut (Table: hex nuts and hex jam nuts); F and G are the same for hex and jam nuts, only thickness differs (H vs H1). F_basic, H_basic and H1_basic are fractions exactly as the standard lists them (strings); all others are decimal inches. Heavy hex nuts are NOT included (different F, G, H). Hex-only verified rows 1-5/8 to 3 (without jam) are in ihn.evidence.txt if the maintainers want a hex-only extension. Sizes shown are the standard series; UNC pitch is not included.
